title: Technical Diagram Standard
idiom: cyanotype blueprint, a signal-flow drawing on a drafting table
hero_prompt: Cyanotype print, white lines on deep Prussian blue, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible paper and cyanotype texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: one large perfect circle with a cross inside it drawn in the middle of a blank blue sheet, a straight arrow entering it from the left and another leaving it to the right, and a brass drafting compass standing open on the sheet with its pencil point resting on the circle's edge. Nothing else drawn on the sheet; a completely unlabelled drawing.
icon_prompt: Cyanotype emblem, a flat single-colour white silhouette on a deep Prussian blue ground, no shading or gradients: a circle with a cross inside it, one arrow entering from the left and one leaving to the right. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
